an4.162:2.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā?
an4.162:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pakatiyā pi tibbarāgajātiko hoti abhikkhaṇaṃ rāgajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti,
an4.162:2.3: pakatiyā pi tibbadosajātiko hoti abhikkhaṇaṃ dosajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti,
an4.162:2.4: pakatiyā pi tibbamohajātiko hoti abhikkhaṇaṃ mohajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an4.162:2.7: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.162:2.8: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābiññā. 3.
an4.162:3.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā?
an4.162:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pakatiyā pi tibbarāgajātiko hoti . . . paṭisaṃvedeti.
an4.162:3.7: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā khippaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.162:3.8: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā. 4.
an4.162:4.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā?
an4.162:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pakatiyā pi na tibbarāgajātiko hoti nābhikkhaṇaṃ rāgajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti,
an4.162:4.4: na tibbamohajātiko hoti nābhikkhaṇaṃ mohajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an4.162:4.7: --so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.162:4.8: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā dandābhiññā. 5.
an4.162:5.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā?
an4.162:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo pakatiyā pi na tibbarāgajātiko hoti nābhikkhaṇaṃ rāgajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti,
an4.162:5.3: pakatiyā na tibbadosajātiko hoti nābhikkhaṇaṃ dosajaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti
an4.162:5.4: na tibbamohajātiko hoti nābhikkhaṇaṃ mohajam dukkham domanassam paṭisaṃvedeti.
an4.162:5.7: imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā khippaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
an4.162:5.8: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
